Dear
Chloë
,
Thank you for contacting our eMobility Support.
We have received your request regarding the following:
Product

Sicharge D - Charging Center
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0453917
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-BE SI E Queue. The first response has been sent to the customer, and we kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / PD 170001336
Charger ID / Serial No.:
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Possible solution:
As reported by the customer, I can see that the CCV terminal needs to be replaced. I will provide you with all the necessary references for the specific Processing Unit CCV Set 24M - CCV KN required for this charger.
If you find that the Credit Card Reader CCV Contactless Flex is also needed, please feel free to order it and take the necessary steps to resolve the issue.
-8EM5903-0AA02-7AA1  Credit Card Reader CCV Contactless
-8EM5903-0AA02-5AA7 Processing Unit CCV Set 24M - CCV KNB
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-BE SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Younes Baroudi
